The forum highlighted Saskatchewan's strengths across the nuclear value chain, from world-class uranium resources to innovation and supply chain development. We're thrilled to be part of the growing momentum behind nuclear energy and the discussions shaping its future. 150053568350107_1509933367823612 feeds_service September 19, 2026 The Athabasca Joint Engagement and Environmental Subcommittee (AJES) recently visited our Rabbit Lake Operation to learn more about upcoming reclamation projects. The visit included a tour of D-Zone Pond, which was reclaimed in 2010, and B-Zone Pond, which after approximately 35 years of environmental monitoring, is ready for the next stage of reclamation. Visits like these help reinforce our collaborative and transparent approach to environmental stewardship.
